text: Under Curry–Howard, the conjunction P ∧ Q corresponds to which type?
explanation: Conjunction P ∧ Q corresponds to the product (pair) type P × Q — a proof of the conjunction is a pair of proofs. The sum type P + Q (A) is disjunction P ∨ Q; the function type (B) is implication; the empty type (D) is falsity ⊥. A common error is swapping which of ∧/∨ maps to ×/+.
